name: Honey Rebel
description: A light bronde that melts soft honey through a gentle brown base. It catches the light without shouting, so it works from boardroom to brunch.
bestFor: Fair to medium skin with warm or neutral undertones

name: Cocoa Muse
hook: Rich brunette with a secret caramel streak.
description: A medium brunette threaded with caramel ribbons that only reveal themselves when you move. Polished, warm and quietly expensive-looking.
bestFor: Light-medium to deep skin with warm or neutral undertones

name: Toffee Riot
hook: Dark roots, loud highlights, zero apologies.
description: A deep brunette base cut through with bold toffee highlights for high-contrast movement. Made for curls and waves that want to be noticed.
bestFor: Medium to deep skin with warm, golden undertones

name: Golden Hour
description: A light golden blonde with buttery warmth from root to tip. Soft enough to feel natural, bright enough to light up your whole face.
bestFor: Fair to medium skin, or deeper skin wanting a bold statement

name: Smoke Signal
hook: Cool, calm and a little bit mysterious.
description: An ashy medium brown with the warmth dialled right down. It reads modern and editorial, and it keeps brassiness firmly off the table.
bestFor: Fair to medium skin with cool or pink undertones

name: Midnight Espresso
hook: Dark, glossy and dangerously easy to wear.
description: A deep, rich brown with minimal dimension and maximum shine. It blends beautifully with natural dark hair, so it looks like yours on day one.
bestFor: Every skin tone — especially medium to deep complexions

name: Wild Card
hook: Brunette at the root. Blonde by the end. Unpredictable throughout.
description: A multi-tonal melt that travels from rich brunette to bright blonde. It is the shade for days you want to walk in and change the room.
bestFor: Light-medium to deep skin wanting high-impact contrast

name: Natural Black
hook: Your hair, only more of it.
description: Uncoloured, cuticle-aligned hair in a soft natural off-black. It matches most natural dark hair and takes colour beautifully.
